stemMd: Events have probabilities $P(E)=0.4$, $P(F)=0.5$, and $P(E\cap F)=0.2$. Find $P(E\cup F)$.
explanationMd: Add the two probabilities and subtract the overlap that was counted twice: $0.4+0.5-0.2=0.7$.

distractorRationale.d: Adds the intersection instead of subtracting it.
